title: Závod se šnekem
desc: Rychlý zajíc se v závodě nudí a usne. Pomalý šnek cestou najde poklad i kamaráda.
desc_en: The fast hare gets bored and falls asleep mid-race. The slow snail finds treasure and a friend on the way.
world: a sunny green meadow with a winding dirt path, wildflowers, a big oak tree, a finish line ribbon between two sticks
setting: Slunná zelená louka s klikatou polní cestou, lučními květinami, velkým dubem a cílovou páskou mezi dvěma kolíky.
music: playful sporty children's music, bouncy clarinet, pizzicato strings and light drums, humorous, instrumental, 110 bpm

hare.name: zajíc Rychlík
hare.desc: a tall slim white hare standing upright on two legs like a person, long ears, red sneakers and a blue sports shirt with the number 1
hare.look: Vysoký štíhlý bílý zajíc, chodí vzpřímeně jako člověk, má dlouhé uši, červené tenisky a modrý sportovní dres s číslem 1.

snail.name: šnek Pomalík
snail.desc: a small cheerful yellow snail with a big swirly orange shell, tiny eyes on stalks and a green cap
snail.look: Malý veselý žlutý šnek s velkou zatočenou oranžovou ulitou, očky na stopkách a zelenou kšiltovkou.

shots.action: Zajíc Rychlík a šnek Pomalík stojí na startovní čáře na louce. Zajíc si protahuje nohy, šnek pomalu kývne.
shots.keyframe: Speedy the hare and Slowpoke the snail stand at a start line on the meadow path
shots.motion: the hare stretches his long legs, the snail slowly nods, both look ahead down the path
shots.narration: Zajíc Rychlík a šnek Pomalík dali závod.
shots.narration_en: Speedy the hare raced Slowpoke the snail.

shots.action: Rychlík vystřelí po cestě a za červenými teniskami se práší.
shots.keyframe: Speedy the hare sprints down the dirt path leaving a cloud of dust behind
shots.motion: the hare dashes away down the path, dust puffs up behind his red sneakers
shots.narration_en: Go! Speedy shot off like an arrow.

shots.action: Pomalík pomalu leze po cestě mezi květinami a očky na stopkách se rozhlíží.
shots.keyframe: Slowpoke the snail crawls slowly along the dirt path among wildflowers
shots.motion: the snail slowly crawls forward, his eye stalks looking left and right at the flowers

shots.action: Rychlík se zastaví u velkého dubu, ohlédne se po prázdné cestě a mohutně zívne. Sedne si ke kmeni, založí ruce a oči se mu zavřou.
shots.keyframe: Speedy the hare leans against a big oak tree by the path, yawning
motion: the hare stops at the oak tree, looks back down the empty path and yawns widely
the hare sits down against the tree trunk, crosses his arms and his eyes slowly close
shots.narration: Rychlík byl daleko napřed. Nudil se, zívl… a usnul.
shots.narration_en: Speedy was far ahead. He got bored, yawned… and fell asleep.

shots.action: Pomalík se zastaví u lesklého modrého kamínku a posadí si ho na ulitu.
shots.keyframe: Slowpoke the snail finds a shiny blue pebble on the dirt path
shots.motion: the snail stops, looks at the shiny blue pebble and puts it on top of his shell
shots.narration_en: Meanwhile, Slowpoke found a shiny pebble.

shots.action: Pomalík dojde k velké červené jahodě, spokojeně k ní přičichne a usměje se.
shots.keyframe: Slowpoke the snail finds a big red strawberry next to the path
shots.motion: the snail reaches the strawberry, sniffs it happily and smiles
shots.narration_en: Then he found a big red strawberry.

shots.action: Pomalík opatrně postrčí brouka, který leží na zádech. Brouk se převrátí na nožičky a zamává.
shots.keyframe: Slowpoke the snail helps a little beetle lying on its back to turn over
shots.motion: the snail gently pushes the beetle, the beetle flips onto its feet and waves its legs
shots.narration_en: And he helped a beetle back on its feet.

shots.action: Pod dubem se Rychlík probudí, uši mu vystřelí nahoru a vyskočí na nohy.
shots.keyframe: Speedy the hare wakes up under the oak tree with a start, ears straight up
shots.motion: the hare opens his eyes, his ears shoot straight up and he jumps to his feet

shots.action: Pomalík s kamínkem a jahodou na ulitě pomalu protlačí cílovou pásku. Páska spadne a on se hrdě usměje.
shots.keyframe: Slowpoke the snail crosses the finish line ribbon carrying a blue pebble and a strawberry on his shell
shots.motion: the snail slowly pushes through the ribbon, the ribbon falls and he smiles proudly
shots.narration: Ale Pomalík už byl v cíli!
shots.narration_en: But Slowpoke was already at the finish!

shots.action: Rychlík se v cíli sehne a potřese Pomalíkovi ručkou, oba se usmívají.
shots.keyframe: Speedy the hare bends down and shakes hands with Slowpoke the snail at the finish line
shots.motion: the hare bends down and shakes the snail's tiny hand, both of them smile
shots.narration: Rychlík mu podal ruku a gratuloval.
shots.narration_en: Speedy shook his hand and said well done.

shots.action: Rychlík v cíli předvede moonwalk, nohy mu kloužou dozadu.
shots.keyframe: Speedy the hare stands at the finish line on the meadow, grinning
shots.motion: the hare does a moonwalk on the spot, sliding his feet backwards smoothly, same red sneakers, same meadow
shots.narration: Pak mu na oslavu předvedl moonwalk.
shots.narration_en: Then he did a moonwalk to celebrate.

shots.action: Rychlík a Pomalík sedí pod dubem a ukusují z velké jahody.
shots.keyframe: Speedy the hare and Slowpoke the snail sit under the oak tree sharing a big strawberry
shots.motion: the hare and the snail take small bites of the strawberry and laugh together
